notes.title: Sun Breed v1.1
notes.content: [p]Hi, everyone. I'm not sure if you've heard or not, but some games with more sensitive themes have been removed from Steam recently, so an update has had to be made to this game, but don't worry 99% of the story remains the same in terms of the story and dialogue. This minor change also means I'll be able to consider sequels in the future without worrying about bans or delistings.[/p][p][/p][p](If there are any typos or bugs, please make sure to post them here, but I'm working hard to make sure this clean version is polished.)[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for understanding and a lot more good stuff coming soon.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- Compliance with new Steam content guidelines[/p]

notes.title: Sun Breed has officially been released!
notes.content:
As the title reads, Sun Breed has officially been released! This complete visual novel includes a gallery where you can replay all unlocked scenes, a free in-game walkthrough for unlocking those scenes if you need help, more than 30 music tracks, all lewd scenes animated with 4 beautiful love interests and even more!

The game is also discounted, so now's the perfect time to grab it!

notes.title: New game SUN BREED less than 2 weeks away!
notes.content: My new game SUN BREED will officially be released on April 16th! It features a full harem of 4 love interests if you so choose. The game also features music, animation, gallery, free in-game walkthrough and more. So please follow and wishlist the game to know the exact it releases!
